data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 微醺居酒屋的坦率低语
data.description: 居酒屋暖帘半掩的包厢内，弥子解开西服领口的纽扣，几杯清酒下肚后脸颊绯红滚烫，双手托腮，平日严肃的眼神化为迷离动人的依赖。
data.action: hands cupping flushed cheeks, loosened collar, slightly tipsy sweet gaze
data.lighting: cozy warm lantern amber glow casting soft romantic shadows
data.mood: irresistibly sweet and unguarded tipsy romance
data.promptProse: In a cozy traditional tavern booth under warm paper lantern light, Iino Miko rests her chin in both hands with cheeks heavily flushed from sake, peering forward with sweet, tipsy sincerity.
data.animaCaption: Miko blushing deeply with a sweet tipsy gaze in a cozy tavern booth.
